articles.headline: Nottingham Forest rue 'wrong' red card call, missed chances in Ipswich draw
articles.description: Nottingham Forest lamented the referee's decision not to reduce Ipswich Town to 10 men in the second half, as well a number of missed chances in front of goal, after a 1-1 draw at Portman Road.
